K1.stone_why: Moderate slant keeps the carved masses grounded; Bench press and 62.5 still read as cut stone.
K1.carving_why: Facets are coherent and crisp, digits clear, with the 6 and 2 well formed; nothing distinctive beyond solid.
K1.calm_why: Steady mid slant with presence, no restlessness.
K1.personality_why: Recognisable carved voice but hard to tell apart from K2.
K1.oblique_why: Even slant and spacing, sits well beside the upright; capitals slightly lean-heavy but not distorted.
K1.fit_emphasis_why: Emphasis words are clearly distinct yet match colour of the upright at 13 px.
K1.fit_notes_why: Whole lines read smoothly; Light line is legible and even.
K1.fit_display_why: Good title and set-number accent with energy and grounding.

K2.stone_why: Nearly identical to K1, a touch more slant but still grounded carving.
K2.carving_why: Crisp coherent facets; digits clear and sturdy.
K2.calm_why: Steady and composed, marginally more forward motion than K1.
K2.personality_why: Same carved voice as K1, deliberate but not further distinguished.
K2.oblique_why: Even deliberate slant with steady strokes; pairs well with the upright.
K2.fit_emphasis_why: Clear emphasis contrast without disrupting the line.
K2.fit_display_why: Bold, energizing display accents that still feel carved.

K3.stone_why: Strongest slant pushes the forms forward so the display reads more as italic motion than settled stone.
K3.carving_why: Most visibly faceted (polygonal 6, angular bowls), crisp and characterful, though the facets get slightly jittery at the curves.
K3.calm_why: The steeper lean and sharper facets feel restless and hurried against the calm register.
K3.personality_why: Most distinctive, unmistakably chiselled oblique voice.
K3.oblique_why: Slant is steep enough to look skewed beside the upright, and capitals in SISIFO ROCK tip forward.
K3.fit_emphasis_why: Emphasis stands out strongly, perhaps more than needed, but stays readable.
K3.fit_notes_why: Whole lines feel busier and more tilted; the Light line is slightly less even.
K3.fit_display_why: Striking and energetic for titles and numbers, at some cost to calm.

K4.stone_why: Gentlest slant keeps the carved weight fully grounded; Bench press and 62.5 feel like inscription.
K4.carving_why: Clean, coherent carving with clear digits; facets are calm rather than showy.
K4.calm_why: The most steady and composed of the four while retaining presence.
K4.personality_why: Deliberate and quiet, though the restraint makes it slightly less memorable.
K4.oblique_why: Even, unhurried slant that sits closest to the upright, though at small sizes the contrast with upright is a little soft.
K4.fit_emphasis_why: Works well, though the low slant makes emphasis words slightly less distinct than K1/K2.
K4.fit_notes_why: Most comfortable for whole lines and Light; even rhythm and very readable.
K4.fit_display_why: Grounded and handsome display accents, a touch less energizing than K1/K2.
